title: TRDP: Fix leaks related to libxml2 xmlGetProp
description:
xmlGetProp in the libxml2 API returns something that must be freed
with xmlFree.

Fixup 696c31892f3aeabcbca5635e9ef795178d0922c5

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: I don't like the "contract" set up that a "make new object function" is passed in memory that it has to free if it fails.  I think the "memory cleanup" should be done at the next layer up.  Yes, less "inlining" of get functions, but I think the code is cleaner that way.
